The sampling area is located in the CSUS Arboretum. The location is about 2.4 m from a moderately used walkway, and about 0.5 m from a fallen Kentucky Coffee Tree (Gymnocladus dioicus) and about 2 m from a live Cestrum aurantiacum, but under its canopy. The location was covered with foliage and plant debris (mostly fallen pine leaves). No green vegetation was observed at the location, but grass and moss were growing about 15 cm away. Additionally, the soil was covered in mulch. When the ground was disturbed, rocks and roots were discovered and an earthworm crawled out from the ground. The sample was collected from a depth of 5 cm below the surface. The weather conditions were overcast, with slight rainfall about 2 hours prior to sampling. This rainfall rendered the soil wet.
